comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: Not available: under 12 months of resale history.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Boon Keng MRT about 370 m, Farrer Park MRT about 470 m; closer than 460 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Hong Wen School about 590 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 12 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 270 m), more than 593 of 662 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Bendemeer Market And Food Centre about 660 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 1,260 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 880 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,010 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,630 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,740 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,800 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,930 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,960 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 2,000 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 302 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 121 new sales and 887 resales (1,008 purchases); new sales were 12% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 550 m; Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,220 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,320 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,960 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 887 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 436 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 887 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 942 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.8%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
